Really like the SPF 50 because it gives me Sun protection while covering some of my facial flaws with the tint.

This is my favorite product! Great sunscreen for everyday wear. With the tint, I have eliminated my foundation for everyday wear. Even during the winter. It's very light weight as well.
I love this tinted moisturizer! It goes on so light and smooth and I feel good to have another layer of SPF on my face.

Love no white pasty look with the tint and it feels lightweight
Love this product! Goes on smoothly, provides nice glow to skin and good SPF. And bonus - it smells nicely too!
The texture is great but unfortunately the tint is much too deep for my fair skin. I will be returning.
Too heavily tinted for me. In the process of returning. Sorry it didn't work for me

This is a fairly nice sunscreen and i like that it is SPF 50. Didn't break me out and applied nicely. I've been avoiding wearing foundation and this gives helps to even my skin tone in the most natural way possible. Gifted by mdsolar

This tinted sunscreen is awesome! The usual sunscreen scent is very light and nearly nonexistant. The application is smooth and even, and feels nearly weightless for the coverage and sun protection provided. This is perfect for my acne prone skin! Although I received this complimentary from MDSolarSciences, I will continue to use the Tint and Tone SPF 50 cream in the future!

I'm obsessed with how this product feels and makes my skin look. It gives a nice coverage that works well under makeup or just as itself. I also love the spf factor of it. A little bit goes a long way. Offered by mdsolarsciences

I like how this tint feels on my skin and how well it covers up imperfections. But I wish there were more shades to choose from. The current shade leans towards warm, light to medium tones, which doesn't align with my cool skin tone 100%. It's complimentary from mdsolarsciences

I like the high SPF protection and the tinted formula that blends well with my skin tone. It feels hydrating and glides smoothly onto the skin. However, I find it slightly greasy on my skin, especially in areas prone to oiliness. It;s complimentary from mdsolarscience

🌞 My go-to this season – SPF50 for serious sun defense without the greasy feel. It's like magic: keeps my sensitive, acne-prone skin happy and gives this effortlessly sheer vibe. Perfect for those low-maintenance, natural looks. Obsessed? Yep, you bet! 🌿💛 Gifted by MdSolarSciences.

This spf tint is amazing on my skin. It doesn't irritate my skin like other spfs and it also moisturizes well. It absorbs quickly and the tint blends in perfectly to where it doesn't look greasy! I wear this every morning and my skin feels very protected.Gifted by mdsolarsciences

Great sunscreen. It doesn't leave a white cast and helps blur out my skin a bit to make no-makeup days even easier. I love that it has a high SPF so I know my skin is covered. Don't forget to reapply every two hours! Gifted by mdsolarsciences

I love that this product is basically an all in one for my morning routine. It goes on smoothly and moisturizes my face, it has vitamin C to brighten my skin, SPF for sun protection and the tint is nice and light for making an even skintone and having the no makeup makeup look. Complimentary from MDSolarSciences

Gifted by MdSolarSciences. One of my new favorite sunscreens this season. SPF50 ensures great UVA/UVB rays protection, moisturizes and gives a sheer look. Perfect for a natural look. Works good for my sensitive, acne prone skin.

This tint sunscreen is perfect! I was worried it was going to look too dark or orangey on my pale skin, but it matched and blended perfectly. I have dry skin so the added hydration was a bonus for me. I also have acne prone skin and it didn't clog my pores or cause a breakout. This is perfect for everyday! Complimentary from MDSolarSciences.

I thought the gleam and glo was good, this is better! I love this all in one pocket sized facial moisturizer and sunblock. Just everything you need in just two pumps. So easy just wash your face with facial wash, wait 5 mins, apply this and your good 👍😊. Thank you so much Mdsolar, y'all killing this skincare game! Especially for brothas!
Have only been using a little while, but I love how my skin is feeling when I do. I also love that it has an SPF of 50.

Love Tint + Tone, I feel so protected and it gives me a lovely dewy tan look! I always thought my other makeup that claimed to have SPF had me protected, come to find it was firstly make up, but not so much SPF, whereas MDSolarSciences is first and foremost SPF with the wonders of beauty coverage.

Tint + Tone feels like a "drink" on your skin and leaves my skin hydrated all day. It gives sheer, lightweight coverage with a hint of neutral tint. You can use it under other makeup if you want more coverage, or wear it alone for a natural look. It's my new daily go-to - and an easy way to start your day with SPF protection!
MdSolarSciences have the best sunscreens, and I don't know how they came up with something like this, but my skin is happy. Blend like a dream on my dark skin. My everyday go to.
I love the new Tint + Tone moisturizer - Makes my skin look even, looks refreshed and easy application. Great for on the go look. A must have in. your daily routine.
Loooovingggg this so far!! I've used the daily perfecting moisturizer for years and am so excited to have a tinted option- with even more SPF! The perfect amount of tint and so lightweight!

I'm always on the hunt for a great tinted moisturizer that I can just apply and go without needing to wear makeup—THIS IS IT! The coverage is sheer, but just enough—and my skin looks and feels smooth and hydrated.—Samantha A
